newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Wednesday at 41.07 points as there were no deals in corporate paper on local bourses, brokers said.

Razvitie Investment Fund's third issue shares were offered at 50 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there no bidders. Biohim shares were also offered there at 580 levs, below the par of 1 000 but no bids were received.
Varna Grand Hotel stocks were bid at 82 levs on the BSE but no one offered, traders said.
There were no offers or demand for corporate stocks on the Sofia Stock Exchange and no repo deals in treasury paper either. -- Rumen Sokolov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
